args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Executed a rollback of checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback for follow-up root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
